entityDescription:
THALENSIA Institute is a high-level training and consulting organization dedicated to cybersecurity, risk governance, and the protection of critical and strategic infrastructures. Positioned at the crossroads of innovation, regulation, and sovereignty, THALENSIA operates with a strong focus on the space, defense, maritime, industrial, and public sectors, helping organizations navigate the complex landscape of digital threats and compliance challenges.
We train and advise executives, CISOs, engineers, and operational teams across Europe to address the evolving requirements of cybersecurity, with a specific expertise in space security frameworks and regulations.

Our areas of expertise include:

- Cybersecurity & Risk Governance Training

Custom-tailored programs covering the full cybersecurity lifecycle: from governance and strategy to operational and technical mastery. 

THALENSIA delivers certified training programs in:
 - GRC, risk analysis, and ISO/IEC 27001/27005
 - Defense and space sector regulations (French, EU, NATO)
 - DevSecOps and secure architecture for critical systems, such as ISO 34000 or IEC62443 and SCADA.

We are an accredited training partner of PECB (ISO/IEC standards) and CompTIA, ensuring globally recognized certifications and high pedagogical standards.

- ECSS Training & Space Sector Compliance

As a specialized institute in the space domain, THALENSIA provides training and advisory services aligned with the European Cooperation for Space Standardization (ECSS) framework. 
We prepare organizations and contractors for compliance with ECSS-Q-ST-80, ECSS security norms, and other technical standards essential to European space missions.

- European Space Cybersecurity Frameworks

We help stakeholders integrate emerging space cybersecurity frameworks such as SPARTA, SpaceShield, and other EU initiatives, enabling secure-by-design approaches to spacecraft, ground segment, and data communication security.
Our experts also support the interpretation and operationalization of the EU Space Law, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, and other relevant acts shaping the regulatory ecosystem of the European space industry.

- CISO Coaching & Strategic Security Support

THALENSIA accompanies New/Old space industries and startups, CISOs and Product security officers in strategic positioning, roadmap definition, and implementation of best practices. We offer coaching programs tailored for security transition phases and regulatory readiness.

- Cyber & Space Intelligence

We maintain a continuous intelligence capability to monitor technological advances, threat evolutions, and normative shifts in the cyber and space domains. This supports our clients in proactive decision-making and long-term resilience building.

Our Commitment:
"At THALENSIA Institute, we believe that security is the foundation of European technological sovereignty. By bridging regulatory requirements and operational excellence, we prepare our clients to thrive in an increasingly contested and interconnected space and cyber environment."

Alexandre OTTER
CEO at THALENSIA

entityName: UNIVERSITY OF ROME TOR VERGATA - CEIS
entityDescription:
The Centre for International Studies on Economic Growth (CEIS – Tor Vergata) is an interdepartmental centreestablished in 1987 in the Faculty of Economics at the University of Rome “Tor Vergata”, which is a public university. 
Its aim is to promote advanced training and high-quality research in economics. CEIS organises seminars and conferences, organizes research in all fields of economics and establishes joint programmes with other universities, national institutions and international organizations.

The centre’s main activities are:
- policy oriented economic research 

- consulting services and technical assistance to private and public institutions
- publishing activities
- conferences and seminars

The centre is engaged in creating international research and higher learning networking in the major fields of economics. Its research agenda continuously changes to reflect new economic phenomena and new projects in partnership with other research centres of excellence and individual scholars. The centre is also involved in international research programs in the framework of bilateral and multilateral cooperation activities.

The research activities focus on the challenges of European economic integration, globalization processes and economic growth. The centre engages in empirical and theoretical analysis of economic policy issues giving special emphasis to international interdependencies between business cycles of regional areas and to the importance of rules and institutions in economic growth. The centre gives top priority to the development of methodologies and tools for the quantitative analysis of economic phenomena and policies.

entityDescription:
The IVB's research focus on fuel cells covers a wide range of hydrogen and fuel cell topics - with the mission of increasing the power density and reliability of fuel cells. A particular focus here is on the polymer electrolyte membrane (PEM) fuel cell and hydrogen storage in metal hydrides.
In our research projects on internal combustion engines, we deal with many issues relating to combustion engines, either simulatively or experimentally. From 0D/1D/3D simulation and design to the investigation of various combustion processes and charge exchange through to exhaust gas aftertreatment, we work on a wide range of topics. New types of fuels are also being investigated in various projects.

entityDescription:
TANIT HORIZON - WHERE HEART MEETS SPACE
TANIT HORIZON is an innovative startup committed to develop advanced technological solutions for agriculture in extreme environments, both terrestrial and extraterrestrial.The company focuses on the research, development, production, and marketing of automated cultivation systems—hydroponic and aeroponic—integrated with technical substrates and technologies adaptable to critical or non-terrestrial climates, including the lunar, Martian, and other space environments.
Our vision stems from a dual challenge: enabling life in Space and improving the quality of life on Earth.Our systems are designed to support life on long-duration space missions, making a tangible contribution to astronauts' food self-sufficiency. At the same time, we bring these innovations to Earth, offering sustainable solutions for agricultural production in dense urban areas, desert regions, or climate-stressed areas.
Technology and sustainability merge in an intelligent system that integrates Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and LED lighting to monitor and adjust optimal growth conditions in real time, improving plant physiological development and optimizing water, nutrient, and energy consumption.
TANIT HORIZON represents a unique convergence of space research, agricultural innovation and environmental sustainability, with significant scientific, social, and humanitarian implications. entityDescription:
CAELUS is an Italian deep tech startup established in October 2023 by current CEO Alessio Iuvara that has set itself the goal of reducing the costs and time of designing, licensing, building and decommissioning nuclear reactors through its unified AI-based software suite. Specifically, the designed product is an enterprise software suite that employs a series of innovative advanced technologies such as AI/ML, NLP, GenAI, HPC/QC, Digital Twins, BIM/GIS, Robotics and other Industry 4.0/5.0 technologies.

Such a mix would allow the nuclear sector to be competitive with other sources of energy generation, and to make realistic the goal of tripling nuclear power, in global terms, necessary to achieve the Net Zero 2050 targets.

The uniqueness of the software is given by the combination of its holistic approach and its ability to follow the entire life cycle of the reactor thanks to architectural specificities, currently in the process of patenting, which can guarantee the complete VV&Q (verification, validation and quality certification) of AI systems, strictly necessary in the nuclear sector as well as for the defense sector. This makes the application usable in high-risk situations, ensuring complete abstraction and generalizability to any engineering of complex systems in highly regulated sectors such as aerospace, maritime and defense.

The product has an intrinsically innovative feature as it creates a new state of the art in the field of dismissal, design and management of nuclear reactors: these processes are currently managed completely by hand, especially for the regulatory field, thus involving a non-negligible amount of errors and delays often discriminating against the success or failure of an entire nuclear project.

CAELUS operates by means of Product Innovation (CAELUS Ecosystem), Process Innovation (Purpose-Specific AI/HW/Software Development and Qualification) and Technical Strategic Consultancy (Ancillary Services) plus operating Commercial Activities such as the Partners Program and the Qualification Program (making possible for companies in business like Aerospace and Defense to go towards the Nuclear market and vice versa by means of qualification, SW and services). Other Programs (Nuke4Africa, Nuke4Hydrogen, Nuke4Space, Coal2Nuclear, Nuke4Datacenters...) are on their way to be launched during the next year.

In this context,Space Technologies such as Satellites, Geospatial Data and Sensors are crucial to ensure efficiency, traceability and safety of the new nuclear sector, reason why we are interested in being inside ESA STAR and apply to multiple collaboration opportunities as they come available through the portal.

entityDescription:
AIRWORKS doo is a newly founded business in Slovenia, to provide physical and digital technologies for applications where performance and safety are mission critical. The company, established in 2025 and 80% owned by AIRWORKS srl and its shareholders (all Italian based), aims to complement the mother company's existing portfolio by adding new solutions in the areas of both space products and digitization.
 
Mechanisms are the primary space industry segment. 
Here AIRWORKS doo intends to provide technologies that address a) unmet needs in the existing market, 2) missing products required by future missions, 3) replacement of non-European components for an EU self-reliant space sector.
 
Business development in the space segment is implemented along two parallel paths: direct collaborations (OHB Group, ArianeGroup, ISAR Aerospace, etc) and open competition within ESA programmes. Having not a background with ESA as space entity yet, it is worth explaining how AIRWORKS doo operates in regard to ESA regulations for geographical return. 
 
AIRWORKS doo is a design and research center in Nova Gorica (Slovenia) that executes its contracts in Slovenia independently from the nationality of its shareholders, particularly from point of view of man labour and project knowledge. The developments are entirely performed by its experienced CTO Mr. Matija Brumat, a team of four competent Slovenian engineers and a few carefully selected local suppliers. Mr. Brumat has considerable heritage in the mechanism segment, being lead mechanism engineer on several Coarse Pointing Mechanism programmes, in respect to design, engineering and MAIT. AIRWORKS doo team is also strengthened by Mr. Paul McMahon, retired senior specialist mechanism engineer and deputy head of the mechanisms group at Airbus Defence & Space UK. Mr. McMahon acts as an engineering mentor providing part-time, “on demand” consulting to the team and will not perform direct work on ESA or commercial projects due to the nature of its contract (zero hours, no obligations of minimum hours from sides)
 
Within the next 1-2 years AIRWORKS doo plans are to expand the staff to 12-15 FTE and implement a facility suitable for space equipment AIT activities.
 
The Italian shareholders play an active role in AIRWORKS doo exclusively in the corporate governance (goal setting, risk management, etc) and as business development accelerators (i.e. connecting AIRWORKS doo with Large Space Integrators to discuss opportunities).

entityDescription:
Animation experts based in Warsaw, Poland. Bones started as a motion capture studio and evolved into full solution for mocap, animation, and content for AAA games, as well as previsualizations. After that, we began venturing into creating datasets for AI, merging science, high quality and lab-like precision.

Perfecting Motion CaptureMotion is at the heart of what we do. Our journey began with motion capture technology, which continues to be foundational to our services. We provide complete solutions from performer casting to final data delivery. We record full performance capture with cutting-edge equipment to ensure precise and natural movement data.
3D Scanning – Capturing ImperfectionsWe operate state-of-the-art 3D scanners that create detailed digital replicas with exceptional fidelity. Our scanning captures what makes people unique – the small details, skin textures, and characteristic expressions that give each person their identity, resulting in truly believable digital humans.
Gameplay Animations – Perfect SynergyOur evolution continued with the creation of an animation department where we’ve gathered seasoned animators. Our talented team delivers high-quality animations that met standards of several AAA titles. By combining motion capture, 3D scanning, and animation expertise under one roof, we create powerful synergies that benefit our clients through faster delivery, reduced costs, and enhanced quality.
Data for Machine Learning – Fueling the FutureWe’ve become a leader in providing data for machine learning. We create custom-made datasets tailored to specific training needs, while also offering our ready-to-train RigPlay – the largest machine learning dedicated dataset of 3D human motion data available. Our data powers innovation at industry giants like Nvidia and Unity, driving the future of animation technology.

entityDescription:
Planetary Solutions for Earth (PS4E) GmbH is a Swiss limited liability company (GmbH) dedicated to leveraging space-based data to create actionable insights and empower communities for a resilient Earth. Guided by the concept “From Space to Ground: Bridging people, data, and purpose for a resilient Earth”, PS4E combines satellite data, practical education, and human empowerment through two strategic pillars:
A. Planet-Centered Initiatives (Short-Term, High-Impact)
Data with a Purpose: Translate satellite and climate data into simple, actionable insights for local disaster preparedness and environmental planning.

Education and Outreach: Deliver hands-on, accessible science programs for youth and communities, fostering climate literacy and practical resilience skills.

B. Human-Centered Empowerment (Long-Term, Capacity Building)
Bridge-Building: Facilitate collaboration between academia, government, and civil society to co-create locally relevant solutions.

Mentorship & Coaching: Support students, early-career professionals, and women returning to the workforce through structured mentorship and skills development.

Pathways for Women Experts: Offer flexible reintegration programs for women who have experienced career interruptions in STEM and policy roles, strengthening local expertise.

PS4E works with research institutions, industry partners, and international organizations to implement projects that connect scientific expertise with real-world applications, supporting innovation, resilience, and sustainable development globally.
